title: Spanish Keto Paella
description: A keto twist on the classic Spanish dish, using rendered tomatoes and protein-rich pa to make it a great keto meal. Serve hot, garnished with fresh tomatoes.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the pa and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the rendered tomatoes, smoked paprika, garlic powder, salt, and black pepper.
Stir to combine, then add the chopped tomaquet.
Cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, until the tomatoes start to break down.
Add the amb, if using, and stir to combine.
Serve the paella hot, garnished with additional chopped tomatoes if desired.
Cooking time will vary depending on the heat and the type of pa used.
Adjust cooking time and seasoning as needed.
